steps.name: branch-identity
steps.command: set -e; echo '=== STATUS ==='; git status --short --branch; echo '=== REFS ==='; printf 'HEAD '; git rev-parse HEAD; printf 'main '; git rev-parse origin/main; printf 'develop '; git rev-parse origin/develop; printf 'merge-base '; git merge-base origin/main origin/develop

steps.name: branch-cherry-audit
steps.command: set -e; echo '=== LEFT main / RIGHT develop; = patch-equivalent ==='; git log --left-right --cherry-mark --oneline origin/main...origin/develop; echo '=== COUNTS AFTER PATCH-EQUIVALENCE ==='; git rev-list --left-right --count --cherry-pick origin/main...origin/develop

steps.name: merge-dry-run
steps.command: set +e; echo '=== DRY MERGE main INTO develop ==='; git merge-tree --write-tree origin/develop origin/main > /tmp/matrixhub-merge-tree.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /tmp/matrixhub-merge-tree.txt; echo MERGE_TREE_RC=$rc; exit 0

steps.name: delta-summary
steps.command: set -e; echo '=== MAIN-ONLY FILES ==='; git diff --name-status origin/develop...origin/main; echo '=== DEVELOP-ONLY CHANGE SUMMARY ==='; git diff --stat origin/main...origin/develop
